def: The pipeline of character filters, a tokeniser and token filters that turns raw text into the terms stored in or looked up in an index.
The normalised unit stored in an index, such as a stem, number or lowercase word, which need not be a dictionary word.
Cutting a string of text into tokens at word boundaries.
Converting different encodings of the same visible text, such as a precomposed é and e plus a combining accent, into one form.
A Unicode operation for caseless matching that handles cases lowercasing misses, such as German ß and SS.
Removing accent marks so that, for example, café and cafe match.
Very common words such as the and of that some analysers drop before indexing.
Reducing words to a shared stem by rule-based suffix stripping, so that refunds and refunded can match.
Reducing a word to its dictionary base form using a vocabulary and its part of speech.
A stemming error that merges words with different meanings, such as news and new.
A stemming error that fails to merge related word forms.
